annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and concise combination of paper arguments

assumptions: There are exactly 2^r real inputs; their signs are unrestricted.
Each rounded addition follows the shared standard addition rule.
The shared recursiveSum definition copies the first input exactly. It does not call rounded addition from zero; that separate model field is kept only for the common interface and library adapters.
Overflow, underflow, and other exceptional machine behavior are outside the mathematical model.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header:
theorem p01_t2_recursive_running_and_pairwise_bounds
    (fp : StandardAddModel) (r : ℕ) (v : Fin (2 ^ r) → ℝ)
    (hvalid : GammaValid fp.u (2 ^ r - 1)) :
    |recursiveSum fp.fl_add (2 ^ r) v - ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ r), v i| ≤
        fp.u * ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ r), |recursivePreRound fp.fl_add v i| ∧
    |recursiveSum fp.fl_add (2 ^ r) v - ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ r), v i| ≤
        gamma fp.u (2 ^ r - 1) * ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ r), |v i| ∧
    |pairwiseSum fp.fl_add r v - ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ r), v i| ≤
        gamma fp.u r * ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ r), |v i|
formal_statement.plain_language: Prove the recursive running-error bound, the recursive worst-case bound, and the independent pairwise bound.

informal_proof: Sum the local recursive-summation rounding errors from equation (2.1) and apply the triangle inequality for the running-error bound. Use equation (2.6) for the independent recursive worst-case analysis and equation (3.6) for the balanced pairwise analysis. Prove r <= 2^r-1 so the larger validity condition also validates r.
informal_statement: For the same 2^r inputs, prove the recursive running-error estimate, the recursive gamma bound, and the pairwise gamma bound.
interpretation_warning: The running-error conjunct uses the exact pre-rounding sums from equation (2.1); bounding those local errors directly gives the factor u form before equation (2.7) rewrites them using rounded partial sums.

source_locations.anchor: equations (2.7)--(2.8) and their preceding local-error derivation

tier_rationale: The proof needs three substantial results unavailable in Mathlib: NumStability.recursiveSum_running_error_bound, NumStability.recursiveSum_forward_error_bound, and NumStability.pairwiseSum_forward_error_bound. The running-error theorem requires a separate induction over local rounding errors and cannot be recovered by a short algebraic step from either gamma bound. Rebuilding all three analyses in N is substantially more work than P01-T1.
